author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-Dual-PCA50-k48: ComBat PCA(50) Embedding + Residualized-PC BalancedGraph (k=48)
abstract: Dual-output BRBG with ComBat-corrected PCA embedding (50 PCs) and residualized-PC BalancedGraph (γ=0.75, l2=1e-3), batch-balanced cosine kNN (k=48, binary). Tests whether 50-PC embedding improves upon the current best 0.7144 (EID 141, PCA64+k=48).

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
from brbg_dual_comb_resid_graph import dual_output_brbg
import anndata as ad

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return dual_output_brbg(
        adata,
        n_pcs_emb=50,
        n_pcs_graph=50,
        gamma=0.75,
        l2=1e-3,
        k_total=48,
        metric='cosine'
    )
